# Sunset Agafay

> A boutique kasbah in the Agafay desert, one hour south of Marrakech, Morocco. Five-star property with restaurants, bar, hammam, pool, and private airport transfers. Open all year.

## Key facts

- Location: Lot Chaabat Ssi Laaroussi · Douar Lamlih · Commune et Caïdat Agafay · Cercle Loudaya · Marrakech-Safi · Morocco · 40000
- Coordinates: 31.444294° N, 8.193362° W (approx. 30 km from Marrakech-Menara airport)
- Rooms: Suites and family rooms
- Star rating: 5
- Languages: English, French
- Contact: via https://sunsetagafay.com/en/contact
- Currencies accepted: EUR, MAD, USD
- Check-in 15:00 · Check-out 11:00
- Cancellation: Fully refundable up to 14 days before arrival; first night non-refundable within 14 days
- Children: Welcome (Family Suite designed for two adults + two children)
- Pets: Not allowed
- Smoking: Not allowed indoors
- Amenities: Pool, Restaurant, Bar, Hammam, Free Parking, Free Wi-Fi, Airport Shuttle, Garden, Library

## Frequently asked

- Getting there: ~30 km south-west of Marrakech-Menara airport, ~45 minutes by road. Private transfers arranged.
- Room rate includes: Breakfast under the pergola, non-alcoholic refreshments, late-afternoon mint tea and pastries, pool, library, courtyards, Wi-Fi.
- Best time to visit: March–May and September–November are most temperate. Open year-round; pool well-used in summer; fires in salons in winter.
- Dietary requirements: Vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, allergies — adapted with 24h notice.
- Events: Intimate weddings 12–80 guests, milestone dinners, corporate retreats, full buy-outs — enquire via the contact page.
